columns_never_fillable.reason: PRIME operates as a single business / geographical segment (US office); no segment note and no per-property NPI is disclosed anywhere in the report (policy Note 3.13, p152). Only portfolio-level NPI of US$69.252m is disclosed (Statement of Comprehensive Income, p135).
Cards disclose Net Lettable Area (NLA) only; GLA/GFA not disclosed.
All 13 properties are Freehold (fee simple) US office; no land-lease term/expiry exists.
Externally managed REIT; the Trust has no employees of its own (p3169). Manager headcount not disclosed.

No FFO/AFFO is disclosed. PRIME reports 'Income available for distribution' (US$28.726m) = distributable income (-> performance.net_distributable_income), not US-style FFO. Per skill rule, FFO is left null rather than equated to net income or distributable income.

data_with_no_home: Weighted average interest rate on borrowings 5.37% (excl. amortisation of transaction costs), Note 9 p162 -> used as cost_of_debt.
67% of total gross borrowings fixed/swapped to fixed (p350).
Total operating expenses (PFA 11.1(L)) US$7,095k = 0.94% of NAV (p185).
Total loans and borrowings US$638.019m; Net assets US$754.883m (p160, p141).
WALE of top 10 tenants 3.4 years (p21); portfolio WALE 5.6 years.
Market capitalisation US$247.2m at US$0.172/unit as at 13 Mar 2026 (p186).
parsing_traps: Two audited valuation tables exist: the Consolidated Portfolio Statement (p141, Fair value) and Investment Properties Note 6 (p157). Both give identical per-property '000 figures totalling US$1,399,600k; market_valuation sourced from p141.
DPU 0.61 US cents is the full-year figure (Distribution Statement p136); comprised H1 0.12c + advanced 0.24c + final 0.25c.
Net fair value change in investment properties is a GAIN of +US$7.442m in FY2025 (P&L, p135) - sign flips vs the prior-year loss; recorded as a positive adjustment.

inferred.basis: Fair-value REIT with no P&L depreciation/amortisation, so ebitda == ebit; derived per standardization formulas.

reconciliation.note: Per-property gross revenue from cards (p25-27) is rounded to US$0.1m; sums to 133.3m vs audited 133.304m (rounding). Per-property NPI structurally not disclosed (single segment).
